title: 'SWIM' Earns Two 2026 MTV VMA Nominations — Song of the Year, Best K-Pop
detail: August 18, 2026 — MTV announced its 2026 Video Music Award nominations, with BTS's 'SWIM' earning two nods: Song of the Year and Best K-Pop. In Song of the Year, 'SWIM' competes against Madonna & Sabrina Carpenter's 'Bring Your Love,' PinkPantheress & Zara Larsson's 'Stateside,' Raye's 'Where is My Husband!,' and HUNTR/X's 'Golden.' In Best K-Pop, 'SWIM' is up against BLACKPINK's 'Jump,' CORTIS, LE SSERAFIM's 'Spaghetti' (featuring J-Hope), Katseye, and Lisa's 'Dream.' The ceremony airs September 27, 2026 from the Peacock Theatre in Los Angeles.

media.caption: BTS's 'SWIM' earns 2026 MTV VMA nominations for Song of the Year and Best K-Pop.

title: Jin's 'Don't Say You Love Me' Surpasses 1 Billion Spotify Streams
detail: August 18, 2026 — Big Hit Music confirmed Jin's solo single 'Don't Say You Love Me,' the title track from his May 2025 EP 'Echo,' surpassed 1 billion cumulative Spotify streams — his first solo track to reach the milestone, achieved roughly 15 months after release. The song peaked at No. 2 on Spotify's Weekly Top Songs Global chart, No. 6 on the Billboard Global 200, No. 4 on Billboard Global Excl. U.S., and entered the Billboard Hot 100 at No. 90 — his third solo entry on that chart. 'Echo' itself debuted at No. 3 on the Billboard 200, a career-best album placement for Jin.

media.caption: Jin's 'Don't Say You Love Me' becomes his first solo track to hit 1 billion Spotify streams.
